title.zh: 修正第514号法的法案，该法题为《设立委员会以征集、整理并在1904年于美国圣路易斯举办的路易斯安那购地博览会中展出菲律宾产品、制造品、艺术、民族学与教育成果的法案》，修正内容为免除在马尼拉举办预展的必要性，并就董事会每位成员及秘书于1904年度因公离家期间，以津贴替代实际差旅费
title.en: AN ACT TO AMEND ACT NUMBERED FIVE HUNDRED AND FOURTEEN, ENTITLED "AN ACT CREATING A COMMISSION TO SECURE, ORGANIZE, AND MAKE AN EXHIBIT OF PHILIPPINE PRODUCTS, MANUFACTURES, ART, ETHNOLOGY, AND EDUCATION AT THE LOUISIANA PURCHASE EXPOSITION TO BE HELD AT SAINT LOUIS, IN THE UNITED STATES, IN NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FOUR," BY DISPENSING WITH THE NECESSITY FOR THE HOLDING OF A PRELIMINARY EXPOSITION AT MANILA AND BY MAKING ALLOWANCES IN LIEU OF ACTUAL TRAVELING EXPENSES FOR EACH MEMBER OF THE BOARD AND THE SECRETARY OF THE BOARD WHILE ABSENT FROM THEIR USUAL PLACES OF RESIDENCE ON THE BUSINESS OF THE BOARD DURING THE YEAR NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FOUR.

title.vi: Đạo luật sửa đổi Đạo luật số 514 về việc thành lập Ủy ban thu thập, tổ chức và trưng bày sản phẩm, hàng hóa, nghệ thuật, nhân chủng học và giáo dục Philippines tại Triển lãm Mua bán Louisiana năm 1904 tại Saint Louis, Hoa Kỳ, bằng cách miễn yêu cầu tổ chức triển lãm sơ bộ tại Manila và chi trả trợ cấp thay cho chi phí đi lại thực tế cho từng thành viên Hội đồng và Thư ký Hội đồng trong năm 1904
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่ห้าร้อยสิบสี่ว่าด้วยการจัดตั้งคณะกรรมการเพื่อรวบรวม จัดระเบียบ และจัดแสดงผลิตภัณฑ์ สินค้า ศิลปะ มานุษยวิทยา และการศึกษาของฟิลิปปินส์ในการจัดนิทรรศการซื้อขายลุยเซียนาปี ค.ศ.1904 ที่เมืองเซนต์หลุยส์ สหรัฐอเมริกา โดยยกเว้นความจำเป็นต้องจัดนิทรรศการเบื้องต้นที่มะนิลา และจัดให้มีเงินช่วยเหลือแทนค่าใช้จ่ายการเดินทางจริงสำหรับกรรมการแต่ละท่านและเลขาธิการคณะกรรมการขณะปฏิบัติหน้าที่นอกสถานที่พำนักปกติในปี ค.ศ.1904
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Undang-Undang Nomor 514 tentang Pembentukan Komisi untuk Mengumpulkan, Mengorganisir, dan Memamerkan Produk, Barang Buatan, Seni, Etnologi, dan Pendidikan Filipina di Pameran Pembelian Louisiana Tahun 1904 di Saint Louis, Amerika Serikat, dengan Menghapuskan Kewajiban Penyelenggaraan Pameran Pendahuluan di Manila dan Memberikan Tunjangan sebagai Ganti Biaya Perjalanan Nyata bagi Setiap Anggota Dewan dan Sekretaris Dewan Selama Berada di Luar Tempat Tinggal Biasa Mereka dalam Menjalankan Tugas Dewan pada Tahun 1904
title.ms: Akta mengubah Akta Nombor 514 yang bertajuk "Akta yang menubuhkan jawatankuasa bagi mengumpul, mengatur dan mempamerkan produk, barang buatan, seni, etnologi dan pendidikan Filipina di Pameran Pembelian Louisiana yang akan diadakan di Saint Louis, Amerika Syarikat, pada tahun 1904", dengan membebaskan keperluan penganjuran pameran awalan di Manila dan memberikan elaun sebagai ganti perbelanjaan perjalanan sebenar bagi setiap ahli lembaga dan setiausaha lembaga semasa berada di luar tempat kediaman biasa mereka dalam menjalankan urusan lembaga sepanjang tahun 1904

text.en:
Section one of Act Numbered Five hundred and fourteen, entitled "An Act creating a commission
to secure, organize, and make an exhibit of Philippine products, manufactures, art, ethnology, and education
at the Louisiana Purchase Exposition to be held at Saint Louis, in the United States, in nineteen hundred and
four," is hereby amended by inserting, after the sentence "The actual traveling expenses of each member,
while absent from his usual place of residence on business of the board, shall be paid out of the Exposition
fund hereinafter provided," the following: "and during the year from January first, nineteen hundred and
four, to January first, nineteen hundred and five, each member of the board shall be allowed, in lieu of his
actual traveling expenses, the sum of ten dollars a day while absent from his usual place of residence on
business of the board."

Section two of said Act Numbered Five hundred and fourteen is hereby amended by adding after
the first paragraph thereof the following: "The secretary of the board shall, when absent from his usual place
of residence on business of the board, be allowed his actual traveling expenses: Provided, That during the
year nineteen hundred and four he shall be allowed, in lieu of his traveling expenses, the sum of seven
dollars a day while absent from his usual place of residence on business of the board."

Section four of said Act is hereby amended by striking out the first sentence thereof, beginning
with the words "The board is authorized" and ending with the word "Manila."

Section five of said Act is hereby amended by striking out of the second paragraph thereof the
words "and the holding of the preliminary exposition at Manila."

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, May 25, 1903.
